commit.summary: publish protocol headers outside source tree

functionality.rationale: Header relocation can break parser, test, or fuzz compilation if any consumer keeps the obsolete include path.

security.rationale: The refactor changes no hostile-input validation or parser behavior.

performance.rationale: Header placement and include visibility do not affect runtime execution.

compatibility.rationale: The canonical C++ include path changes while parser signatures and wire behavior must remain identical.

concurrency.rationale: The refactor changes no mutable state, callbacks, threads, or synchronization.

platform.rationale: CMake include visibility and path handling must remain valid on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

persistence.rationale: The refactor changes no persisted product or governance format.

adr.rationale: The accepted module boundaries and protocol contract are unchanged.

architecture.rationale: The protocol module inventory gains its canonical public include root.

roadmap.rationale: This internal boundary repair completes no product milestone.
